subject: Welcome Week kickoff — scheduling, roles, and meeting links
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Anya Patel <anya@chartwellhealth.com>, Ben Turner <ben.turner@chartwellhealth.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Welcome Week kickoff — scheduling, roles, and meeting links

Hi Anya / Ben —

Excited to get Chartwell onboarded. We want to lock in a 90-minute Welcome Week kickoff during the week of June 22 to cover goals, access, and the first two sprints of the implementation. Proposed windows (all CT):

- Tues 6/23, 10:00–11:30 CT
- Wed 6/24, 14:00–15:30 CT
- Thurs 6/25, 09:00–10:30 CT

Agenda (draft):
- 10 min — Introductions & outcomes
- 20 min — Product orientation (overview of endpoints, auth, and region pins)
- 25 min — Implementation plan (sprint 0 & week 1 milestones)
- 20 min — Access & security items (SSO, data retention, audit log needs)
- 15 min — Action items & next steps

Internal attendees from our side: me (Rishi, AE), Olga Petrov (Implementation Lead), Kimberly Park (Customer Success).

Please confirm which window works best and flag any extra attendees or access items we should add to the prework. If none of the above fit, send three preferred times and we'll accommodate.

I’ll attach the preflight checklist and our standard security questionnaire for your security team. Once we confirm time I’ll send a calendar invite with Zoom + a short dry‑run slot for our engineers.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood-preflight-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet), chartwell-security-questionnaire.pdf (PDF)

Hi Rishi —

Thanks — excited to get going. Our core team prefers mornings CT next week. Candidate windows that work for us:

- Wed 6/24, 09:30–11:00 CT (preferred)
- Thurs 6/25, 09:00–10:30 CT

Adding Liam O'Connor (implementation PM) to the thread; he'll need visibility on the SSO and firewall items. Our security lead asked that you share the questionnaire as a downloadable link (we had issues with large PDFs in previous exchanges) — otherwise the attached PDF is fine.

One ask: can we reserve 15 minutes at the end for a short run of the SSO flow (test user) with our engineer? That'll help unblock SSO setup during sprint 0.

Best,
Anya
Director of Digital Ops | Chartwell Health
anya@chartwellhealth.com
(312) 555-0114
